subject: Software stocks have had a painful year
notes: Seawolf Therapeutics: Versant Ventures is stated as lead of the seed round only; no Series A lead is named. Citrix item: the issue text reads 'roughly $600 loss' with no unit. EnergySolutions and DRT Aerospace are PE-to-PE deals in the EXITS list, included as listed acquisitions.

stories.headline: Corma raises $125M Series A led by NEA
stories.quote: Corma, a Tel Aviv- and San Francisco-based developer of AI foundation models for defensive cybersecurity, raised $125 million in Series A funding. NEA led the round and was joined by existing investors Sequoia Capital, KhoslaVentures, and Coatue.
stories.description: Developer of AI foundation models for defensive cybersecurity

stories.headline: Noeri launches with $110M led by Menlo Ventures
stories.quote: Noeri, a Palo Alto, Calif.-based lab building self-improving AI for enterprises and scientific discovery, launched with $110 million in funding. Menlo Ventures led the round and was joined by MadronaVentureGroup, KindredVentures, WingVentureCapital, NEA, Cisco Investments, NVIDIA, and Snowflake.
stories.description: Lab building self-improving AI for enterprises and scientific discovery

stories.headline: Seawolf Therapeutics emerges from stealth with $100M across seed and Series A
stories.quote: Seawolf Therapeutics, a San Diego-based developer of DNA-based therapeutics, emerged from stealth with $100 million raised across seed and Series A rounds. VersantVentures led the seed round; Series A investors included Versant, MPMBioImpact, and others.

stories.headline: Numa raises $45M Series C led by Blue Cloud Ventures
stories.quote: Numa, a Silicon Valley-based provider of AI software for auto dealerships, raised $45 million in Series C funding. BlueCloudVentures led the round and was joined by ThresholdVentures, Costanoa, and others.
stories.description: Provider of AI software for auto dealerships

stories.headline: Knit Health raises $35M Series A led by NEA
stories.quote: Knit Health, a San Francisco-based healthcare AI company developing models to predict and improve patient care, raised $35 million in Series A funding. NEA led the round and was joined by Town Hall Ventures, SignalFire, and existing investors.
stories.description: Healthcare AI company developing models to predict and improve patient care

stories.headline: Remanence raises $30M seed led by EQT Ventures and FirstMark
stories.quote: Remanence, a Paris-based platform helping businesses build and own tailored AI models, raised $30 million in seed funding. EQT Ventures and FirstMark led the round and were joined by Zero Prime, Emblem, Drysdale, GlobalFoundersCapital, Yellow, and angel investors.
stories.description: Platform helping businesses build and own tailored AI models

stories.headline: Fairly raises $22M Series A led by Oregon Venture Fund
stories.quote: Fairly, a Portland, Ore.-based vacation rental management marketplace, raised $22 million in Series A funding. OregonVentureFund led the round and was joined by Elevate Capital and Breon.

stories.headline: Bevado raises $10M seed led by RET Ventures
stories.quote: Bevado, a New York City-based provider of AI agents for leasing and resident services, raised $10 million in seed funding. RETVentures led the round and was joined by PearVC.
stories.description: Provider of AI agents for leasing and resident services

stories.headline: Mosaico raises €7.5M seed led by United Ventures
stories.quote: Mosaico, a Reggio Emilia, Italy-based provider of open-source sensor data management software for robotics and physical AI, raised €7.5 million ($8.2 million) in seed funding. United Ventures led the round and was joined by OpenOcean and returning investor ConnectVentures.
stories.description: Open-source sensor data management software for robotics and physical AI

stories.headline: Daisytuner raises €6M seed led by Elaia and LEA Ventures
stories.quote: Daisytuner, a Darmstadt, Germany-based developer of software that optimizes AI model performance across chips, raised €6 million ($6.6 million) in seed funding. Elaia and LEAVentures led the round and was joined by Amadeus APEX Technology Fund and Seedcamp.
stories.description: Software that optimizes AI model performance across chips

stories.headline: Thoma Bravo took Kneat private for roughly $454M; agreed in June, completed in August
stories.quote: In June, Thoma Bravo agreed to take software company Kneat private for roughly $454 million, completing the deal in August.

stories.headline: Silver Lake has held talks to buy Workday, per Reuters in August
stories.quote: Silver Lake, meanwhile, has held talks to buy Workday in what could become one of the largest software buyouts in history, Reuters

facts.text: Reuters reported the talks in August, citing sources familiar with the matter.
facts.quote: reported in August, citing sources familiar with the matter.

stories.headline: Bumble agreed on 13 Oct to a $1.3B all-cash sale to Ithaca Holdings
stories.quote: Then there is dating site Bumble, which agreed to a $1.3 billion sale to Ithaca Holdings on Oct. 13.

facts.text: Photo caption describes the deal as an all-cash take-private valued at $1.3 billion.
facts.quote: Bumble is being taken private by Ithaca Holdings in an all-cash deal valued at $1.3 billion.

facts.text: PitchBook had flagged Bumble and Varonis as acquisition targets this year.
facts.quote: PitchBook, which this year correctly flagged Bumble and Varonis as acquisition targets

stories.headline: Thoma Bravo-backed Proofpoint announced a $6.3B acquisition of Varonis on 15 Oct
stories.quote: Two days later, Thoma Bravo-backed Proofpoint announced a $6.3 billion acquisition of software and cybersecurity company Varonis, which is expected to close in the first half of 2027.

facts.text: Expected to close in the first half of 2027.
facts.quote: which is expected to close in the first half of 2027

stories.headline: Citrix's 2022 buyout cited as an example of banks struggling to sell acquisition debt
stories.quote: Just look at cloud software company Citrix. Banks backing its 2022 buyout sold $8.55 billion of acquisition debt at a

facts.text: Banks sold $8.55 billion of acquisition debt at a loss (issue text: 'roughly $600 loss', no unit), then sought to sell another $3.8 billion in bonds in 2023.
facts.quote: roughly $600 loss , then sought to sell another $3.8 billion in bonds in 2023.

stories.headline: Energy Capital Partners acquired EnergySolutions from TriArtisan Capital Advisors; terms undisclosed
stories.quote: EnergySolutions, a Salt Lake City- and Charlotte, N.C.-based provider of nuclear lifecycle services, from TriArtisan Capital Advisors. Financial terms were not disclosed.

stories.headline: GenNx360 Capital Partners acquired DRT Aerospace from Mill Rock Capital; terms undisclosed
stories.quote: DRT Aerospace, a Cincinnati-based manufacturer of precision-machined components for the aerospace, defense, space and industrial gas turbine markets, from Mill Rock Capital. Financial terms were not disclosed.
stories.description: Manufacturer of precision-machined components for aerospace, defense, space, gas turbines

stories.headline: Gemspring Capital raised $3.5B for its fourth buyout fund
stories.quote: Gemspring Capital, a Westport, Conn.-based middle-market private equity firm, raised $3.5 billion for its fourth buyout fund.

stories.headline: PitchBook lists public software companies most likely to be taken private in the next 18 months
stories.quote: has put together a list of software companies it sees as most likely to go private over the next 18 months, based on past deals, quarterly financial statements, and share price performance relative to peers.

facts.text: PitchBook's Steven Buibish named BILL, Rapid7 and First Advantage among public software companies with the cash-flow profile.
facts.quote: He pointed to other public software companies like BILL, Rapid7, and First Advantage.

facts.text: BILL generated roughly $83 million in free cash flow in the quarter ended 30 Sept.
facts.quote: BILL generated roughly $83 million in free cash flow in the quarter ended Sept. 30.

facts.text: Rapid7 produced $26.5 million despite a 2.5% year-over-year revenue decline; First Advantage reported an adjusted EBITDA margin of about 29%.
facts.quote: Rapid7 produced $26.5 million despite a 2.5% year-over-year revenue decline, while First Advantage reported an adjusted EBITDA margin of about 29%.

facts.text: Fastly is on the list but has much faster revenue growth than the others.
facts.quote: Fastly, for example, has much faster revenue growth than the others, he said.

facts.text: The Federal Reserve hiked interest rates in September; higher borrowing costs could slow deals.
facts.quote: the Federal Reserve hiked interest rates in September and sticky inflation could bring more increases.
